title: Convex Density Design for Regional Phase-Volume Contraction of Nonlinear Systems
summary: Regional weighted phase-volume contraction for nonlinear systems is studied using positive densities selected from a finite-dimensional log-affine family. The affine dependence of the density divergence on the design parameters turns density selection into a semi-infinite convex optimization problem that maximizes a certified uniform contraction margin on a compact region. This provides a constructive alternative to testing a preselected density and ensures a well-posed design problem under compact parameter constraints.
